question:
**Direction: Choose the correct spelling of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

We are going on a hiking **__expidition__**.
solution:
The correct answer is "expedition."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

__
 
• The word **"expidition"** is spelt incorrectly.
 
• The correct spelling is **"expedition."**
 
• The correct spelling of the word **"expedition" **in the sentence** "We are going on a hiking expedition" **is important for clarity and effective communication.
 
• It means a long journey for a special purpose. (उद्देश्‍य विशेष से की गई लंबी यात्रा, अभियान; खोजयात्रा)
 
 
• **Example**: *We're going on a shopping **expedition**__ on Saturday.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

Correct sentence: *We are going on a hiking __**expedition**__.*
